description: This file defines the AccessTokenInterface in the league/oauth2-client library, specifying the methods related to OAuth2 access tokens.

classes.name: AccessTokenInterface
classes.description: Interface defining the methods for OAuth2 access token representation.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Returns the access token string of this instance.

methods.name: getRefreshToken
methods.description: Returns the refresh token, if defined.

methods.name: getExpires
methods.description: Returns the expiration timestamp in seconds, if defined.

methods.name: hasExpired
methods.description: Checks if this token has expired, possibly throwing a RuntimeException if 'expires' is not set.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Returns additional vendor values stored in the token.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the access token.

methods.name: jsonSerialize
methods.description: Returns an array of parameters to serialize when this is serialized with json_encode().
